summary: @or-sdk/agents preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (identifiers like `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, string-property indirection maps). It downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle whose contents are opaque under shuffled string-array obfuscation with a `WV8StW`-style array-rotation decoder. Neither the runtime download nor the local execution of math_init.js is disclosed in the README, which advertises only a REST SDK client. The filename `math_init.js` does not correspond to anything in the advertised agents SDK. Using a downloaded alternate JS runtime to execute an opaque local bundle at install time bypasses Node-based install auditing and prevents review of the executed code before it runs on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
